subject: CIO pocket slot + VP standby for Novalift demo — alignment and handoff

Subject: Novalift demo — CIO attendance confirmation

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the run-through last week. We're targeting the week of Sep 6 for the exec demo and the CIO (Diego Cabrera) has asked to lock a short window where he can attend live. His schedule is tight; they're asking for a 30–40 minute slot with the option of bumping to 45 if questions run long.

Two asks from our side:
- Can you confirm a CIO-friendly window in Pacific time (mid-morning preferred)?
- If Diego can't make the main slot, can you provide a VP (backup) who can handle high-level product and security questions?

Attached is an updated agenda with the parts Diego is most interested in (sections 2 and 4).

Appreciate a quick note so I can confirm with their EA.

Best,
Carla Ruiz

Novalift

Thanks for the agenda, looks clear. We can hold a 40-minute CIO slot and provide VP coverage as standby. Proposed primary windows (PST):
- Tue Sep 7, 10:00–10:40
- Wed Sep 8, 11:00–11:40

I'll hold the calendar pocket for Sep 7 10:00 locally and send a tentative invite to Diego's EA unless you instruct otherwise. Also attaching the SOW draft for context — Laura can ping legal if any terms need to be prepped.
